title: Yellow Crucible of Words
description: A muscular, emaciated humanoid figure kneels inside a large bronze cauldron filled with thick, glowing yellow liquid. The figure holds an open black book with glowing yellow text while looking upward, as viscous yellow substance drips from a cracked stone arch above inscribed with runic text.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene of a muscular emaciated humanoid figure kneeling inside a large bronze cauldron filled with swirling glowing yellow liquid, holding an open black book with glowing yellow runes, looking upward as thick yellow viscous substance drips from a cracked stone archway covered in ancient inscriptions, an anvil covered in yellow drips to the left, a candelabra with three lit candles to the right, stone floor with scattered yellow puddles, dark occult atmosphere with dramatic lighting
